quotes.text: hog2 De las personas que residen habitualmente en esta vivienda, ¿todas comparten los gastos para alimentación?
pers2. De las personas que mencionó previamente, ¿quién es el proveedor principal del hogar?
pers8. ¿Qué relación de parentesco tiene [Nombre de persona] con [Nombre de persona de proveedora principal]?
pers9. ¿Cuál es el sexo de [Nombre de persona]?
pers13. ¿Cuál es el estado cónyugal actual de [Nombre de persona]?

assessments.reasoning: The questionnaire collects marital status (pers13) and maps household presence/absence and relationships (pers8) as well as migration (mig1-mig6), enabling the distinction between de jure (e.g., single/divorced/widowed) and de facto (married with absent partner) female main providers; hence de_jure_vs_de_facto is true. Women-maintained households are explicitly captured by identifying the main economic provider (proveedor principal, pers2/pers6) and recording their sex (pers9); thus women_maintained_by_provider is true. However, because pers8 records kinship strictly relative to the main provider, relationships between secondary members (such as an adult daughter and her own child in a complex household) cannot be directly linked, so unpartnered_mother_child_units is false. Finally, while hog2 identifies shared food expenses, the instrument contains no variables mapping consumption, production, or care activities specifically to mother-child hearth-hold sub-units, so mother_child_unit_activity is false.
